name: Selloway AI Chat for WooCommerce
author: Selloway

sections.description:
Most WooCommerce stores lose sales the same quiet way: a shopper lands on a product page, has a question they can’t get answered fast, and simply leaves. You never even see the lost sale.

Selloway fixes that by speaking first. Instead of a silent chat bubble that waits to be clicked, Selloway greets each visitor with a proactive, product-specific message — then answers their questions in seconds and guides them toward checkout.

What makes Selloway different

  • It starts the conversation. Every product page opens with a friendly first message, so hesitating shoppers get pulled in instead of bouncing.
  • A unique first message for every product. For each product you can write your own custom greeting — or generate a unique one automatically with AI in one click. No generic “How can I help?” on every page.
  • It actually knows the product. Answers are built from each product’s own name, price, and your key selling points — not a generic FAQ bot that repeats the same lines everywhere.
  • Built to sell, not just support. Selloway is tuned to answer the “which one is right for me?” and “will this work?” questions that decide a purchase, and to nudge the shopper toward adding to cart.

Key features

  • Proactive, per-product AI greeting (custom text or AI-generated, unique per product)
  • Product-aware answers in ~2 seconds, 24/7
  • Per-product key selling points and add-to-cart message
  • 80+ languages — auto-detect the visitor’s language or fix one
  • Tone control (Professional, Friendly, Casual, Luxury)
  • Notification bubble that draws attention without being annoying
  • Conversation analytics and chat memory across page reloads
  • Idle reminders to re-engage visitors about to leave
  • Full appearance control (colors, fonts, position, branding) with live preview
  • 5-minute setup, no code

Who it’s for

WooCommerce store owners who want more sales from the traffic they already have — especially stores where shoppers have real questions before buying (supplements, coffee, apparel, electronics, home goods, and more).

External services

This plugin relies on the Selloway API (https://api.selloway.com), operated by Selloway, to generate the AI chat responses. AI replies cannot be produced locally, so the relevant data must be sent to this service.

What is sent and when:

  • When you connect your store (admin action): your license key, site URL, admin email, and plugin/WordPress/WooCommerce versions — to authenticate and register the store.
  • When you sync products (admin action): product name, price, description, URL, and the greetings / selling points / add-to-cart message you configure — so the AI can answer about each product.
  • When a visitor uses the chat: the visitor’s messages, the current product context, and conversation identifiers — to generate and return the AI reply.

No data is sent to any other third party. Service provided by Selloway:

  • Terms of Service: https://selloway.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://selloway.com/privacy
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Selloway adds the AI chat to your WooCommerce product pages, so WooCommerce 3.0 or later must be installed and active.

Do I need to connect a separate API or bring my own AI key?

No. You do not need an OpenAI key, a separate API, or any technical setup. Just install Selloway, paste your Selloway license key in Settings, and click Connect — the AI works right away. Everything is handled for you.

What makes Selloway different from other chat plugins?

Two things. First, Selloway speaks first — it greets shoppers proactively instead of waiting to be clicked. Second, every product can have its own unique first message (written by you, or generated with AI), and answers come from that product’s real details — not a one-size-fits-all script.

Can I write the first message myself, or let AI do it?

Both. On each product you can type your own greetings, or click “Generate with AI” to create a unique, on-brand message in one click. You can mix and match across your catalog.

Where does the AI run?

On Selloway’s secure cloud. The plugin talks only to Selloway and never connects directly to any other third-party service. (Required details are listed in the “External services” section below.)

Will it slow down my store?

No. The widget is lightweight and only loads on product pages, so the rest of your store is untouched.

Can I customize how the chat looks?

Yes. From Settings you control colors, fonts, position, size, and branding, with a live preview as you edit.

How do I set up per-product AI responses?

Edit any product and scroll to the Selloway box. There you add greetings, key selling points, and an add-to-cart message — or generate them with AI.

What languages are supported?

80+. Selloway can auto-detect each visitor’s language or stick to one you choose.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. You can start free and upgrade when you’re ready for more conversations and features.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • New: Sales Audit — a built-in conversion scanner. A short survey plus an automated scan of your store returns an overall sales-health score and per-category scores (engagement, product content, trust, merchandising, setup, SEO) with prioritized, plain-English fixes.
  • The audit recommends turning on your AI Sales Agent where it will recover the most lost sales.

0.3.0

  • New brand: Selloway AI Chat for WooCommerce.
  • Proactive per-product greeting — custom text or one-click AI-generated, unique per product.
  • “Powered by” badge is a pure admin opt-in (default off).
  • Removed the Custom CSS field; appearance is configured through structured controls only.
  • All admin styles/scripts are now enqueued (no inline code).
  • Documented the external Selloway API service.

0.2.0

  • Appearance customization, language settings, live preview, security and stability fixes.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
